issue.title: test_reload_allows_a_previously_missing_target_to_resolve loses the missing-target notification in the broad lane
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1pn.3 note #3. ToolRun 15740c604fa23ba51d679d4c7b5472cb failed once in the broad scoped lane: at test_rendered_link_navigation.py:202 the notification list contained neither not found nor unavailable after following the missing target. The phase reports serial passes on clean base and unchanged worktree; the lander independently passed the node at 7e562f58f8. Population failure rate and root cause are unknown; load is an inference. The close-guard diff does not change pager behavior. Search across all task statuses and the past-week sweep found no duplicate. No established causal ownership in active epics. Preserve the notification/follow timing evidence and fix the test or implementation at its cause, without loosening assertions.
